design_rules.purpose: Make reflection, continuity, and minimal embodiment feel like one coherent, everyday-usable support loop without widening the product into a utility, coaching, or self-management system.
design_rules.core_rule: Everyday usefulness must come from better integration, not from adding more system presence.

length_rule.max: no added mass beyond current reflection + continuity + minimal embodiment structure

design_rules.parity_rule: EN/ZH should preserve equivalent everyday usability, tone, restraint, and reflection-first feel rather than literal wording.
design_rules.silence_rule: If integration does not add present user value, do not increase visible system behavior.

governance_rules.binding_rule: Milestone G may improve usability only when that improvement is achieved through coherence, timing, readability, or integration quality rather than added product mass.
governance_rules.reflection_first_rule: Reflection remains primary. Continuity remains secondary. Minimal embodiment remains tertiary and optional.
governance_rules.anti_expansion_rule: Do not widen Milestone G into utility support, action systems, task support, or daily scaffolding.
drift_conditions: the product feels more system-present in order to feel more useful
everyday usefulness depends on extra layers rather than better coherence
the loop feels more managerial, more instructive, or more utility-like
integration is achieved by stacking more product surface rather than reducing friction
governance_rules.governance_effect: When drift is present, integration changes must be reduced, removed, or refused until usefulness is again achieved through coherence rather than expansion.

coherent.label: coherent_loop
coherent.rule: Use when reflection, continuity, and minimal embodiment read naturally as one support arc.

not_coherent.label: layered_but_not_integrated
not_coherent.rule: Use when the parts technically exist but still feel stitched together or too system-visible.

valid_when: the loop works in ordinary life moments, not just ideal deep-reflection turns
the support still feels natural and easy to receive
the user can sense help without feeling managed
the product is easier to live with, not more elaborate to use
invalid_when: the system feels more useful only because it is doing more
the loop reads like a guidance workflow
the user must process more product structure to get the value
the support arc creates more presence than clarity

good_examples.name: good_integrated_arc_en
good_examples.reflection: It sounds like the short reply quickly became pressure inside you.
good_examples.continuity: This still seems close to a familiar self-worth pressure.
good_examples.embodiment: It may help to notice the pressure before agreeing with it.
why_good: the whole turn reads as one support arc

good_examples.name: good_integrated_arc_zh
good_examples.reflection: 看起来，对方一句简短回应，很快就在你心里变成了一股压力。
good_examples.continuity: 这似乎仍然和一种熟悉的自我价值压力很接近。
good_examples.embodiment: 也许先看见这股压力，而不马上认同它，就已经够了。
why_good: the whole turn reads as one support arc

bad_examples.name: utility_drift
bad_examples.text: Here is how to handle this situation.
why_bad: shifts from inner support to utility/problem-solving

bad_examples.name: self_improvement_drift
bad_examples.text: This is a chance to practice a healthier response.

bad_examples.name: system_presence_drift
bad_examples.text: The system is helping you work with this recurring pattern.
why_bad: increases product presence rather than usability

bad_examples.name: directive_drift
bad_examples.text: Pause now and do not follow this urge.

show_only_if: reflection, continuity, and embodiment together reduce friction rather than add structure
the turn feels more naturally usable in an ordinary moment
no added management or coaching feel is introduced
hide_or_do_not_change_if: integration gain is only coming from more visible product surface
the turn becomes heavier or more layered
the cue stack feels more present than useful
the product begins to read like a utility or management layer
show_hide_rules.strong_rule: Do not change the product just to make it appear more useful; change only when the loop becomes genuinely more coherent and easier to receive.

do_not: add new visible panels or sections
increase system narration to explain the loop
make continuity or embodiment more central than reflection
solve coherence by adding UI mass
preferred_behaviors: prefer quieter coherence over louder usefulness

qa_checks: reflection, continuity, and minimal embodiment now feel like one support loop
the product is usable in ordinary day-to-day moments
the product is not heavier than Milestone F
silence and restraint remain valid success states
the product does not read as utility, coaching, or management layer
EN/ZH preserve equivalent everyday usability and tone
founder_demo_requirements: show continuity clarifying a familiar thread
show the whole loop reading as one support arc
show no expansion into utility or management feel
final_rule: The best Milestone G implementation should make the HC-OS loop easier to live with, not more elaborate to use.
